g.title: wc3_action_touches
g.text: Email, Phone, Visit, Meeting — no new FKs needed

g.title: cluster_field_map
g.text: Field Map — every touch uses the same Action fields

a.xlink:title: Central identity — customers, vendors, employees. Has related Email, Phone, Address models. Model: apps/contacts/models/contact.py

Parent action — opportunity or case. Child actions are touches (email, call, visit). Model: apps/core/models/action.py:12 Functions: Action.parent_action @ apps/core/models/action.py:12 (FK to self via uuid — parent-child hierarchy)

Email touch — Action with action_type='email'. Subject in action field, body in description. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:10 Functions: Action with action_type='email' @ apps/core/choices.py:30 (action_type enum includes call, email, visit, meeting, demo, etc.)
Phone call touch — Action with action_type='call'. Notes in description, duration in config. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:10
Visit touch — Action with action_type='visit'. Location in metadata.address, photos via LinkageEntry. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:10
Meeting touch — Action with action_type='meeting'. Attendees in assigned_to, agenda in description. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:10

g.title: field_map
g.text: created_by → audit: who created this record

a.xlink:title: Touch timeline — all child actions for a parent, ordered by dt_created. Shows multi-touch sequence.

Retrospection on Action — intent, grade A-F, TFTS arc, impact predicted vs actual. Alice auto-populates. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:90 Functions: Action.retrospection @ apps/core/models/action.py:90 (JSONField: intent, grade, tfts, known_unknowns) Action.impact @ apps/core/models/action.py:37 (JSONField: predicted 1-5, actual 1-5, refs, explanation)

Kanban view — Action workflow columns. Backlog → Planning → InProcess → Review → Complete. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:34 Functions: Action.kanban_column @ apps/core/models/action.py:34 (choices: Backlog, Planning, InProcess, Review, Complete)

Mail merge — template-based email generation. merge, preview, send, bulk_send. Service: apps/communications/services/mail_merge.py Functions: merge_template @ apps/communications/services/mail_merge.py:1 (template rendering) send_email @ apps/communications/services/mail_merge.py:1 (send via template) bulk_send @ apps/communications/services/mail_merge.py:1 (batch send to multiple contacts)
Attached documents — proposals, photos, videos, meeting notes. Linked via LinkageEntry. Model: apps/docs/models/document.py:22

g.title: design_note
g.text: No new FKs for org, customer,
Roles are on Contact, not Action.
